body.label: Trigger
body.html: An effect would move you or move an adjacent ally.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Reduce that movement by 2 units. If you are in a Titan Adaptation, you may also move the source 1 unit away from you.

surges.html: If the source is within your natural weapon reach, deal 1 natural weapon damage to it after reducing the movement.
Increase the reach or affected distance of this Reaction by 1 unit.
